chapter.name: Jnana Vijnana Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna explains the nature of ultimate reality, combining theoretical knowledge (jnana) and realized wisdom (vijnana). This chapter reveals the divine nature, the material and spiritual energies, and how devotion leads to true understanding of God.
chapter.theme: Understanding the Supreme through knowledge, realization, and devotion
chapter.yogaType: Jnana Vijnana Yoga - Yoga of Knowledge and Realization

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः | असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | mayy āsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjan mad-āśrayaḥ | asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tac chṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: O Arjuna, hear how you can know Me fully by practicing yoga with mind attached to Me.
verses.meaning: Krishna begins teaching how to know the divine completely through devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः | यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ||
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ te 'haṃ sa-vijñānam idaṃ vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ | yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo 'nyaj jñātavyam avaśiṣyate ||
verses.english_translation: I will explain knowledge along with realization, knowing which nothing more remains to be known.
verses.meaning: True knowledge includes both theory and direct experience.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये | यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ||
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścid yatati siddhaye | yatatām api siddhānāṃ kaścin māṃ vetti tattvataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among thousands, few strive for perfection, and among those, hardly one truly knows Me.
verses.meaning: Realizing the divine truth is rare.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च | अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ||
verses.transliteration: bhūmir āpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhir eva ca | ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtir aṣṭadhā ||
verses.english_translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and ego are My eightfold material nature.
verses.meaning: Krishna explains the components of material existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् | जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ||
verses.transliteration: apareyam itas tv anyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām | jīva-bhūtāṃ mahā-bāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ||
verses.english_translation: Besides this, there is a higher nature—living beings who sustain the universe.
verses.meaning: There is a spiritual energy beyond matter.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय | अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ||
verses.transliteration: etad yonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇīty upadhāraya | ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā ||
verses.english_translation: All beings arise from these two energies; I am the origin and dissolution of the universe.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the source of all creation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय | मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ||
verses.transliteration: mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyat kiñcid asti dhanañjaya | mayi sarvam idaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva ||
verses.english_translation: There is nothing superior to Me; everything is strung on Me like pearls on a thread.
verses.meaning: All existence depends on the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः | प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ||
verses.transliteration: raso 'ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśi-sūryayoḥ | praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu ||
verses.english_translation: I am the taste in water, the light in the sun and moon, the sacred syllable Om, and strength in humans.
verses.meaning: Divine presence exists in all aspects of nature.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ | जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ||
verses.transliteration: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaś cāsmi vibhāvasau | jīvanaṃ sarva-bhūteṣu tapaś cāsmi tapasviṣu ||
verses.english_translation: I am the fragrance of earth, the heat in fire, the life in all beings, and austerity in ascetics.
verses.meaning: God is the essence of all existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् | बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: bījaṃ māṃ sarva-bhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam | buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham ||
verses.english_translation: I am the eternal seed of all beings; I am intelligence in the intelligent and brilliance in the brilliant.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the origin of all qualities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् | धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ||
verses.transliteration: balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāma-rāga-vivarjitam | dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo 'smi bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english_translation: I am strength free from desire and passion, and desire that is in harmony with dharma.
verses.meaning: Pure strength and righteous desire are divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये | मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ||
verses.transliteration: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāś ca ye | matta eveti tān viddhi na tv ahaṃ teṣu te mayi ||
verses.english_translation: All states of nature arise from Me, but I am not bound by them.
verses.meaning: The divine is beyond the three qualities of nature.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् | मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṃ jagat | mohitaṃ nābhijānāti mām ebhyaḥ param avyayam ||
verses.english_translation: The world is deluded by the three qualities and does not recognize Me as the supreme.
verses.meaning: Illusion prevents realization of truth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया | मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ||
verses.transliteration: daivī hy eṣā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā | mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṃ taranti te ||
verses.english_translation: This divine illusion is hard to overcome, but those who surrender to Me cross it easily.
verses.meaning: Devotion helps transcend illusion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः | माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ||
verses.transliteration: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ | māyayāpahṛta-jñānā āsuraṃ bhāvam āśritāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who are deluded, evil, and deprived of knowledge do not surrender to Me.
verses.meaning: Ignorance and ego prevent devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन | आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ||
verses.transliteration: catur-vidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino 'rjuna | ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english_translation: Four kinds of virtuous people worship Me: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise.
verses.meaning: People approach God for different reasons, but all are on the spiritual path.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते | प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ jñānī nitya-yukta eka-bhaktir viśiṣyate | priyo hi jñānino 'tyartham ahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among them, the wise one, devoted to Me, is the most dear, and I am dear to him.
verses.meaning: Pure devotion with knowledge is the highest form of worship.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् | आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tv ātmaiva me matam | āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: All these devotees are noble, but the wise one is My very self.
verses.meaning: The realized devotee is closest to the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते | वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ||
verses.transliteration: bahūnāṃ janmanām ante jñānavān māṃ prapadyate | vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: After many births, the wise realize that everything is Vasudeva; such a soul is rare.
verses.meaning: Ultimate realization comes after long spiritual evolution.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः | तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ||
verses.transliteration: kāmais tais tair hṛta-jñānāḥ prapadyante 'nya-devatāḥ | taṃ taṃ niyamam āsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā ||
verses.english_translation: Those whose knowledge is stolen by desires worship other deities.
verses.meaning: Desire-driven devotion leads to limited goals.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति | तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ||
verses.transliteration: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitum icchati | tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tām eva vidadhāmy aham ||
verses.english_translation: I strengthen the faith of those who worship different forms.
verses.meaning: Krishna supports all forms of sincere devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते | लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ||
verses.transliteration: sa tayā śraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate | labhate ca tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān ||
verses.english_translation: Through faith, they obtain their desires, which are granted by Me.
verses.meaning: All results ultimately come from the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् | देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ||
verses.transliteration: antavat tu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tad bhavaty alpa-medhasām | devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api ||
verses.english_translation: The fruits of such worship are temporary; devotees of gods go to them, but My devotees come to Me.
verses.meaning: Devotion to Krishna leads to the highest and eternal result.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः | परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ||
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ vyaktim āpannaṃ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ | paraṃ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam ||
verses.english_translation: The ignorant think of Me as having a limited form, not knowing My higher nature.
verses.meaning: Divine reality is beyond physical form.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः | मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yoga-māyā-samāvṛtaḥ | mūḍho 'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam ||
verses.english_translation: I am not manifest to all, being veiled by divine illusion.
verses.meaning: Maya hides the true nature of God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन | भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ||
verses.transliteration: vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna | bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana ||
verses.english_translation: I know past, present, and future, but no one truly knows Me.
verses.meaning: Divine knowledge is infinite and beyond human understanding.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत | सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ||
verses.transliteration: icchā-dveṣa-samutthena dvandva-mohena bhārata | sarva-bhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa ||
verses.english_translation: All beings are deluded by dualities arising from desire and aversion.
verses.meaning: Duality creates confusion and ignorance.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् | ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ||
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ tv anta-gataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇya-karmaṇām | te dvandva-moha-nirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍha-vratāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those freed from sin and delusion worship Me with determination.
verses.meaning: Purity leads to steady devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये | ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ||
verses.transliteration: jarā-maraṇa-mokṣāya mām āśritya yatanti ye | te brahma tad viduḥ kṛtsnam adhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam ||
verses.english_translation: Those striving for liberation from old age and death take refuge in Me and understand everything.
verses.meaning: Seeking liberation leads to complete knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः | प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ||
verses.transliteration: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ | prayāṇa-kāle 'pi ca māṃ te vidur yukta-cetasaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who know Me as the governing principle of matter, divinity, and sacrifice remember Me even at death.
verses.meaning: True realization leads to divine remembrance at the final moment.
